headline: Review National Trust access for Murlough
reservation: Access to the nature reserve is typically open; however, specific conservation zones may have restricted entry. Check the official National Trust site for seasonal updates regarding the North Point nature trail and site-specific guidance.

days.title: Dunes and Biodiversity

stops.name: Murlough
stops.detail: Walk the self-guided nature trail through the reserve to spot rare marsh fritillary butterflies and diverse flora. Follow the boardwalk towards the beach for views of the Mourne Mountains and historical conservation sites.

days.driving: Allow 10-20 minutes from local gateways; conditions vary
days.note: Stick to marked boardwalks to protect fragile dune biology and keep dogs on leads at all times.

intel.title: Boardwalk Navigation
intel.text: The route to the beach is clearly marked with signage from the avenue leading toward Murlough House. Follow the boardwalk from the concrete standing to ensure wildlife is not disturbed.

intel.title: Wildlife Viewing
intel.text: Visit during warmer months to observe the 22 species of butterflies found on-site. The marsh fritillary is a key species of European importance active in specific seasons.

intel.title: Arrival Point
intel.text: The trail begins near the concrete standing area; parking availability is not specified in current sources. Verify local parking capacity before departure.

intel.title: Regional Services
intel.text: Fuel locations are not identified within the reserve boundaries. Travelers should secure supplies in nearby Newcastle or Dundrum.

intel.title: Connectivity Gap
intel.text: Cellular signal strength is undocumented for the dune and beach areas. Download trail maps or trail descriptions before entering the reserve.

plan.arrival: Arrive via the A2, pick up supplies in Newcastle, and proceed to the Murlough House avenue for trail access.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for regional roads; check for height or width restrictions on the access avenue.
plan.goldenHour: North Point trail views at sunset with the Mourne Mountains backdrop; seasonal light varies.
